metric: frame_risk = max calibrated risk over tracks in the frame
note: Isotonic calibrator saturates at 0.35408: p90 = p100 = 0.35408, so 14.55% of val frames sit exactly at the maximum. A 5% block rate is therefore not achievable without a different calibrator. The threshold is set to the highest calibrated bin so the gate actually fires; GT is not used in the decision.
